name: The Documented Record — published data
description: Every dataset behind the charts at palestinerecord.github.io, as plain JSON over HTTPS, with no login and no key.
licence: The compilation is published for re-use with attribution to The Documented Record. The underlying figures are not ours to licence: each record names the body that recorded it, and that body's terms govern the figure itself.

datasets.title: Dated events for the series
datasets.description: The events marked on the time series — ceasefires, offensives, crossings closed and reopened — so a change in a line can be read against what happened.
datasets.source: OCHA situation reports and contemporaneous reporting.

datasets.title: The children’s record, 1948 to the present
datasets.description: Every child this record can count, on both sides, period by period and year by year: three windows counted in full from a single source that counted both sides on one methodology, the partial figures that cover only one side or one territory marked as such, and the periods nobody counted published as gaps rather than estimated.
datasets.source: B’Tselem, Remember These Children, Defence for Children International – Palestine, OCHA, the Gaza Ministry of Health via Tech For Palestine, and the Israel National Council for the Child; each row names the one that recorded it.

datasets.title: The chronology of recorded crimes
datasets.description: Appendix B of the report: every dated crime and massacre in the record, split out of report.json so the Timeline can be read without loading the full report.
datasets.source: The report, Appendix B.

datasets.title: Conduct of the war
datasets.description: Aid, hospitals, schools, heritage, journalists, medics and what remains functioning, measured against the obligations each engages.
datasets.source: WHO, UNRWA, UNESCO, OCHA, CPJ and Physicians for Human Rights.

datasets.title: The elements of the legal tests
datasets.description: The elements of genocide, apartheid and the grave breaches, each set against the evidence advanced for it and the body that made the finding.
datasets.source: Genocide Convention, Apartheid Convention, Rome Statute, Fourth Geneva Convention.

datasets.title: The curated statistics
datasets.description: The headline figures and the topic groups behind them — each with its label, its value, the note that qualifies it, and the report section it came from.
datasets.source: Each record carries its own source field.

datasets.title: The first screen
datasets.description: The eight headline figures, the current ratio and the counts, in one small file so the record can state what it establishes before the rest of the data arrives.
datasets.source: A subset of figures.json, timeseries.json and report-meta.json; each figure keeps its own source field.

datasets.title: The pre-October-2023 baseline and the undercount
datasets.description: West Bank annual tolls and settler violence rates before October 2023, together with the undercount layer: the Lancet capture–recapture estimate, the Gaza Mortality Survey, and the bodies under the rubble.
datasets.source: B'Tselem, OCHA, The Lancet, and the Gaza Mortality Survey.

datasets.title: Proceedings, findings and instruments
datasets.description: The ICJ cases and their orders, the ICC warrants, the treaty provisions engaged, and the findings made under the Genocide, Fourth Geneva and Apartheid Conventions.
datasets.source: ICJ and ICC filings and orders; UN Commission of Inquiry reports.

datasets.title: The long record, 1917–2026
datasets.description: Dispossession, detention, demolition, recognition and complicity across the whole period, as series rather than as single figures.
datasets.source: Each record carries its own source field.

datasets.title: Map geometry
datasets.description: The boundaries, governorates and place points the maps are drawn from, joined to the data by name with the aliases resolved.
datasets.source: Public-domain and openly licensed boundary data.

datasets.title: The depopulated villages of 1948
datasets.description: Each village depopulated in 1948 with its district, its population, the date and the means, mapped point by point.
datasets.source: Walid Khalidi, All That Remains; Salman Abu Sitta, Atlas of Palestine.

datasets.title: A slice of the identification list
datasets.description: A short excerpt of names.json, loaded while the record loads, so the count is not the only thing on screen.
datasets.source: Gaza Ministry of Health, via Tech For Palestine (public domain).

datasets.title: The identification list
datasets.description: The named dead of Gaza as published by the Ministry of Health: name in Arabic and in English, age, sex and date of record. Two megabytes; loaded only on request.
datasets.source: Gaza Ministry of Health, via Tech For Palestine (public domain).

datasets.title: The report, described
datasets.description: The title, the counts (words, parts, sections, tables) and the full bibliography of the report, without the text — what a page needs to quote the report accurately when it is not reproducing it.
datasets.source: Derived from the report by build.py.

datasets.title: The source report, parsed
datasets.description: Every part, section, paragraph, list, table, chronology entry and bibliography entry of the report, converted losslessly by build.py and checked by verify.py. This is the whole document as structured data.
datasets.source: The report — A Forensic Academic Survey of State Conduct, Alleged Violations of International Law, and the Documented Record (1917–2026).

datasets.title: The linked source library
datasets.description: The evidentiary base grouped by kind: courts and tribunals, UN bodies, human rights organisations, open datasets, academic work, Israeli sources, journalism and archives.
datasets.source: Each entry links to the publisher.

datasets.title: Documented statements of intent
datasets.description: Statements by named officials with speaker, role, date, the verbatim quotation, its context, its evidentiary categories, its tier and its legal significance. Contested attributions are marked contested.
datasets.source: Primary reporting as cited per record; §6.2 and Appendix C of the report.

datasets.title: The contextual chronology
datasets.description: The legal and political steps between the massacres recorded in Appendix B — mandates, partitions, laws, plans, rulings, resolutions and admissions.
datasets.source: Primary documents as cited per entry.

datasets.title: Daily and monthly casualty series
datasets.description: Killed and injured in Gaza and the West Bank, day by day and aggregated by month, with the reporting gaps left as gaps rather than interpolated.
datasets.source: Tech For Palestine, from Gaza Ministry of Health and OCHA reporting (public domain).

datasets.title: The wars and 7 October
datasets.description: Each Gaza campaign, what it was called, what it killed, and what the inquiries into it found — alongside the documented record of 7 October 2023.
datasets.source: UN Commission of Inquiry, OCHA, B'Tselem and Israeli state inquiries.

datasets.title: State positions
datasets.description: Recognition of Palestine, arms embargoes, ICJ interventions, sanctions and Security Council vetoes, by state, with the date each position was taken.
datasets.source: UN records; national foreign ministry statements.
